name: Horizon
description: Fetches, scores and summarizes news from RSS, Hacker News, Reddit, X and GitHub into daily AI briefings, run as a self-hosted CLI or MCP server.

skills.name: Aggregate Sources
skills.description: Fetches and deduplicates items from RSS, Hacker News, Reddit, Telegram, X, GitHub and Google News into one run.

skills.name: Score and Filter
skills.description: Scores each item with AI against profile rubrics and thresholds, then filters it and merges repeated stories.

skills.name: Generate Daily Briefing
skills.description: Generates daily briefings in English and Chinese as Markdown, with summaries, background context and community discussion.

skills.name: Deliver Briefings
skills.description: Delivers briefings to a GitHub Pages site, email subscribers, WeChat, or Slack, Discord and Feishu webhooks.

skills.name: Staged MCP Pipeline
skills.description: Runs the fetch, score, filter, enrich and summarize stages as separate MCP tools and reads artifacts from past runs.
